amber: Amber and Rob met on All-Stars and married. A cheap card that rewards building around Rob.
carolyn: Her unpredictable energy became a random move. Strong for 1 fire, but you don't control where she lands.
erik: He famously gave away his immunity necklace. Lots of influence for 1 fire, with a built-in gift to the enemy.
jt: He mailed Russell an idol in Heroes vs. Villains. Big value for 1 fire, but he hands the opponent protection.
cochran: The superfan strategist is all about information, so he's card draw: a weak body that keeps your hand full.
maryanne: An underdog winner who came from behind, so she gets stronger when outgunned.
natalie: She won after her twin was voted out first, playing for revenge. Grows as your tribe falls.
rick: He returned from the Edge of Extinction. Hard to get rid of, and great with Kass.
spencer: A survivor who kept outlasting tribals on the bottom. A slow grower in vote-heavy games.
david: Known for his idol finds. Weak himself, but protects a whole location.
fairplay: The "dead grandma" lie: manipulation that knocks the top threat down a peg.
kass: "Chaos Kass" flipped on her own alliance. Sacrifices allies for power; the engine of the Vote Out deck.
malcolm: Remembered for big idol plays. A payoff for idol decks.
michele: She won from what looked like a losing spot. A comeback card for when you're behind.
parvati: A master of alliances and numbers, so she rewards going wide at a location.
q: He openly asked his tribe to vote him out. High influence, but self-destructs if outmatched.
russell: Famous for finding idols without clues. Spreads protection across the board.
sandra: "As long as it ain't me." Survives every vote and profits from everyone else's.
tina: A winner who did best when underestimated. Shines when outnumbered.
tony: The spy shack: he reads the other side. Rewards guessing where your opponent will play.
tyson: A self-inflicted boot in Heroes vs. Villains. A cheap power spike that leaves; also feeds Natalie and Chris.
brian: He took a "goat" to the end and won. Clogs the opponent's spaces.
chris: Won after coming back from the Edge. A payoff for losing a card.
jerri: An early-era villain. Weakens a whole location rather than one card.
kenzie: A social winner who helped everywhere. A board-wide buff.
ozzy: A challenge beast at home on his own. Wants a location to himself.
rachel: A recent winner. Built as a payoff for decks running scenarios.
rob: "Rob's Army": an alliance leader who lifts everyone around him.
rupert: He stole the other tribe's shoes in Pearl Islands. Literal stealing.
sarah: A winner who built momentum all game. Scales late.
yamyam: A social winner who brought people together. A permanent version of Rob's boost.
ben: Won his season through fire-making. Huge at the two "survival" locations.
cirie: Survivor's great persuader. Turns an opponent's player into yours.
colby: A challenge beast so dominant he overshadowed his own side.
jeremy: He used other big players as "meat shields." Protects his allies.
joe: A pure challenge beast: simple, strong, reliable.
hatch: Formed the first alliance in Season 1. An ongoing boost everywhere else.
dee: A dominant winner who ran clean blindsides. Precise removal.
earl: A unanimous winner. Rewards a dominant game.
kim: One of the most dominant runs ever. Controls a location while she's there.
jeff: The host's twist of the day. Inspired by Marvel Snap's Nico Minoru: seven Survivor twists (draw, flint, drop your buffs, immunity, come on in, fire-making, the tribe has spoken) are shuffled each game and he cycles one per turn, never repeating. Cheap so he can land on any turn; Legends because he's the host.
westman: A challenge powerhouse. The game's biggest single body.
necklace: The classic immunity win. Cheap, targeted protection.
shotdark: The show's real gamble. Cheap, but it usually misses.
extravote: An advantage that adds weight to one player.
nullifier: The show's counter-advantage. A hard answer to idol decks.
reward: A reward feast fuels the whole tribe.
tribeswap: Swaps break up power. Relocates a threat instead of removing it.
doordie: The show's literal coin-flip twist. High risk, high reward.
rocks: Drawing rocks: pure chaos that can hit your own card.
blindside: The show's signature move. The cleanest removal, so it costs the most.
kelly: The original swing vote in Season 1. She shifts where your next play actually lands.
phillip: He called himself "the Specialist" with an undercover-agent persona. A mole: his negative influence drags down the opponent's total and takes one of their spaces.
wade: The "Dragon Slayer" rallying his followers. Pulls your best card to where you need it.
rudy: The Season 1 Navy SEAL who never wavered from his alliance. Nothing can move him or turn him.
ethan: The beloved Africa winner kept his allies steady. Shields your cards from being weakened.
lex: He blindsided his closest ally in Africa. Gives up a friend for power.
vecepia: She won Marquesas by flying under the radar. Grows quietly as long as someone else is the biggest threat.
robc: The original strategist who flipped votes in Amazon. Turns the opponent's strength into yours.
chrisd: He won Vanuatu from the bottom by flipping at the very end. A late comeback payoff.
terry: His immunity streak in Panama kept growing. Gets a little stronger every turn.
yul: He used the super idol in Cook Islands as leverage. Rewards holding idols.
yauman: He gave away the car he won, hoping for a deal. Helps the enemy now, pays you back in cards.
dreamz: He broke his promise at the final four in Fiji. Strong at the end, but costs his allies.
james: He was voted out in China with two idols in his pocket. Idols make him bigger, never safer.
bob: The Gabon winner crafted fake idols. Clogs the opponent's hand with a useless card.
steph: The last of her tribe in Palau, outnumbered every vote. Gets stronger the more enemies surround her.
ian: He gave up the final immunity in Palau for his friends. Steps aside when you're far ahead to lift the rest.
tai: The gentle gardener of Kaôh Rōng tended his crops for later. Plant now, more fire next turn.
wendell: The Ghost Island winner is a furniture maker who built the camp. Keeps adding fire while he's around.
flint: Every tribe's most precious reward. A small, permanent boost to your fire.
elisabeth: She played Australia, the only 42-day season. Reshapes her location into the Outback and stretches the game to 7 turns.
holloway: Five individual immunity wins in Worlds Apart. The biggest body in the game, if you can find the fire to play him.
nwhite: She won Samoa so quietly that nobody saw it coming. Cards near her stay hidden until the votes are read.
